contextPassage.title: The Dream Journey
contextPassage.text:
One sunny morning, a young student named Leo left his house with a book and a pen in his pocket. He walked down the street past the bus stop, dreaming of becoming a developer who could build intelligent machines.
At the park, he sat under a tree and watched a bird fly across the sky. "Like that bird," he thought, "I want my work to reach high places." He opened his laptop and started writing code—simple programs that felt like games at first, but would one day become something meaningful.
A friend passed by with a cup of coffee. "What are you building?" she asked.
"An AI helper," Leo smiled. "Something to assist students like us, maybe even doctors and farmers one day."
That night, back in his room, Leo looked out the window at the moon and stars. He knew the road ahead would be long, but every year of learning brought him closer. With his computer glowing in the dark and his head full of ideas, he felt ready.
Every great city starts with one small garden. Every amazing journey starts with one simple step.
